items.quote: The Company has recorded its highest-ever consolidated revenue of Rs.4,850 crore in Q2FY27, up by 20% on YoY basis as against Rs.4,026 crores.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA Rs 343 crore, up 28% QoQ; margin 7.1% vs 6.8% in Q1
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA for Q2FY27 was recorded at Rs.343 crore as compared to Rs.268 crore in Q1FY27, up by 28% sequentially.

items.statement: Net debt Rs 5,696 crore as of 30.09.26, up Rs 751 crore QoQ due to capex and working capital
items.quote: Consolidated Net debt as on 30.09.26 stood at Rs.5,696 Cr, up by Rs.751 crore on QoQ basis.

items.statement: Capacity utilization above 90% across key segments in India
items.quote: Capacity utilization levels in India remained high at above 90% across key segments including TBR, PLR, 2/3W etc.

items.statement: Targeting INR 1 lakh crores annual sales; aiming for 11 million ton production in FY27 with 6 million tons in H2
items.quote: Our aim is to reach to about 11-million-ton production in this financial year as targeted earlier. We have reached to a level of about 4.79 million tons in H1. And the next, that is H2, we are aiming for 6 million tons.

items.statement: Confident of achieving 3 million tons per quarter in H2; production planning at 960,000 tons per month
items.quote: So, we are quite confident that we'll be in a position to achieve these 3 million tons per quarter. So that means 1 million ton per month. To be very precise, the production planning is 0.96 million tons, that is, 960,000 tons per month.

items.statement: Targeting 65% flat products (including plates) and 35% long products mix
items.quote: We are now aiming to increase our overall product mix towards flat products. Though today also, we are at a level of about 60% -40%. Now we'll be reaching somewhere about 65%-35%, 65% flat products, including plates and 35% will be long products.

items.statement: Annual growth capex guidance of INR 7,500-10,000 crores; H1 FY27 spend INR 3,187 crores; INR 8,000-9,000 crores remaining on INR 47,000 crores plan
items.quote: Our stated framework envisages annual growth capex of approximately INR 7,500 crores to INR 10,000 crores, primarily funded through internal accruals, while seeking to maintain net debt to EBITDA below 1.5x through the cycle.

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA INR 2,504 crores, up 34% YoY; EBITDA per ton INR 10,529, up 5% YoY; sequential moderation due to higher raw material and operating costs
items.quote: Our adjusted EBITDA stood at INR 2,504 crores, up 34% Y-o-Y, while adjusted EBITDA per ton increased 5% Y-o-Y to INR 10,529 per ton. The sequential moderation in EBITDA was primarily due to higher raw material and operating costs.

items.statement: Coking coal cost impact guided at $20-25 per ton for Q3; West Asia conflict diesel impact $4-5 per ton; slurry pipeline saving INR 700 per ton from commercial start
items.quote: the coking coal inflation, right, just to be sure. Sandeep Modi: No, coking coal, I said $20 to $25. And for the West Asia conflict, which I think you are reflecting more on the diesel and other part, we did not give INR 1,200, INR 1,300. We said around $4 to $5, and that continued to be around $4 to $5 per

items.statement: Coal gasification saving INR 70 per kg vs propane; switched reheating furnaces, galvanizing and color-coating lines to syngas permanently
items.quote: You see the propane prices have gone up to a level of about INR 100 per kilo. And equivalent when we make coal gas, that is called syngas, then equivalent, we were getting in INR 30 a kilo. So that advantage was INR 70 a kilo.

items.statement: Domestic steel demand growing ~10% YoY; exports ~100,000 tons/month; optimistic on Q3/Q4 with festival season and construction pickup
items.quote: The steel scenario is very good. I think it is now around 10% Y-o-Y basis, there's a growth. Though our production has gone up by 20%. The industry overall growth is about 10%.

items.statement: Water availability not a concern; using 31 MLD vs 59 MLD sanction; slurry pipeline water recycling reduces consumption further
items.quote: We do not need 59 MLD now. We are using only 31 MLD, which is sufficient. And in next year, we'll be using at least 15% less. Why? Because we are pumping water from Barbil. So, this water will be surplus.

items.statement: Net debt-to-EBITDA improved to 1.51x from 1.71x; net debt INR 14,786 crores; cash INR 7,237 crores
items.quote: Our consolidated net debt declined by INR 1,141 crores from INR 15,927 crores at the end of June to INR 14,786 crores as at September end. Net debt-to-EBITDA ratio improved from 1.71x to 1.51x.

items.statement: New pellet plant (4th) commissioning by June 2025; current 3 plants producing 33,000 tpd all consumed internally
items.quote: As far as the new pellet plant is concerned, yes, it is on the way. On the way means it has come up. Hopefully, by June next year, this will be fully commissioned.

items.statement: Locked in capex of more than INR100,000 crores to be delivered in 4 to 5 years.
items.quote: And we have already locked in capex of more than INR100,000 crores and that we will be delivering in another 4 to 5 years. So asset will grow almost 1.3x, 1.4x from what we have today in next 5 years.

items.statement: Deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in first half across all businesses.
items.quote: In fact, since we have been focusing continuously on capex delivery on the ground, and we see now results coming up, the capex in this first half of the year in the all-time high. We have deployed about INR7,850 crores of capex in among all our businesses.

items.statement: Transmission order book remains at about INR87,000 crores after adding two projects.
items.quote: As far as Transmission is concerned, during this quarter, we added another two projects. One is at Vizag Pendurthi and second one is Satara. And with these two projects, our order book remains at about INR87,000 crores.

items.statement: Expects total transmission capex of about INR14,000 crore, with INR8,000-9,000 crores in second half.
items.quote: We expect to do total capex of transmission in the range of about INR14,000 crore. So we will be doing about INR8,000 crores to INR9,000 crores of capex in second half.

items.statement: Expects additional transmission capex of INR6,000 crores in H2 and INR18,000-19,000 crores in FY28.
items.quote: See, as we said in the earlier question, we actually expect to incur to INR6,000 crores additional capex in the second half of this year and another INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores in the FY '28.

items.statement: Transmission capitalization expected at INR8,000-9,000 crore this year and about INR10,000 crores next year.
items.quote: Capitalization would be about, give me a minute, that will also be of the order of INR10,000 crores. The capitalization will jump after the subsequent years after next year because of commissioning of those HVDC projects, that will add capitalization in lump.

items.statement: Plans to scale aggregate capacity on both sides to 7,000-8,000 megawatts over 3 to 4 years.
items.quote: So in terms of volume, we will certainly continue to scale up this. And currently, we have about 2,500 megawatts of MSEDCL PPA. We will be doing another PPA with AEML, where regulatory approval has already been achieved, so we will be doing that PPA.

items.statement: Long-term PPA margins expected in the order of INR0.80 to INR1 on a consistent basis.
items.quote: So we will tie up on a long -term basis where those margins will be in the order of INR0.80 to INR1 on a consistent basis.

items.statement: MSEDCL 2,500 MW PPA capacity starts deploying from end of February, then April and July.
items.quote: In terms of time lines and the capacity, 2.5 gigawatts MSEDCL signed, the capacity starts being deployed from end of February this year, 1,000 megawatts, then 1,000 megawatts from end of April and then another 500 megawatts end of July in the next year.

items.statement: AEML 750 MW PPA approved by regulator, execution expected over next 3 to 4 weeks.
items.quote: As far as 750 megawatts is concerned, that's already approved by the regulator. All process already done. We are in the process of executing that, expect that to happen over the course of next 3 to 4 weeks.

items.statement: Plans about 80 to 90 lakh smart meters this year, balance 40-45 lakh in next half year.
items.quote: So we plan for about 80 to 90 lakh meters this year. And the balance about 40 lakh, 45 lakh, we hope that we will be able to complete in the next half year.

items.statement: About 60% of smart metering order book delivered; balance to complete in 12 to 14 months.
items.quote: Smart Metering, we have now delivered about 14.8 million meters so far. And around 60 percentage of our order book, that we have delivered and balance portion, we wish to complete in another 12 to 14-month time.

items.statement: Debt largely fixed rate or hedged; 75-80% of debt portfolio on fixed coupon basis.
items.quote: No, no, no. All our USD bonds modes and ECBS, the interest rates are fixed. So 75% to 80% of our debt portfolio is on fixed coupon basis.

items.statement: Intellismart transaction expected to close in next one month after CCI approval.
items.quote: And we expect the CCI approval very soon. And once we have the CCI approval, we will complete the transaction immediately. So we expect that will happen in next one month time.

items.statement: Merchant volumes expected around 3,500 million units per quarter on overall basis.
items.quote: You are right. But again, we have to be mindful of the fact that renewable, both wind and solar will be a seasonal profile. But on an overall basis, it would be of the order of 3,500 million units per quarter.
